instruction: Click into the left Choose a value box. Open the dynamic content picker and select Attachments Name.
title: Animation: open the picker from the Choose a value box, search for name and pick Attachments Name
intro: Press Play to watch step 3: the lightning bolt, a search for name, then Attachments Name.

steps.caption: Click into the left Choose a value box.
Select the lightning bolt beside it. The picker opens, but Attachments Name isn't in the short list.
Click into the picker's search box and type name.
Attachments Name comes straight up. Select it.
